themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of autonomous research tasks, decision-making, and execution within research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and refactoring code, including code generation and quality checks.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to facilitate various aspects of user research.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Articles discussing the use of AI to create various forms of content, from text and code to design elements.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to condense large amounts of information, such as meeting transcripts, research findings, or articles, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI survey tools
themes.description: Articles related to AI applications in survey design, deployment, analysis, and the use of synthetic data for surveys.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being used in the design process, including UI generation, design system integration, and creative tooling.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, including creation, elimination, and the changing nature of work and skills required.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of artificial user profiles or data for testing, simulation, and research purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on research into the behavior, impact, and efficacy of AI chatbots, particularly in user interaction and decision-making.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
